Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory.

About the job

This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves.

You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first-class part of the work.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets.
  • Own the retrieval path that answers "what do we know about this person?" in milliseconds, working with embeddings, vector search, and ranking
  • Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships.
  • Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces.
  • Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Experience building backend services, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages, frameworks, and tools as the problem demands.
  • A curious approach to service management: ability to investigate how systems actually behave in production, and desire to continuously learn how to operate them with rigor and accountability.
  • Experience building or working with evaluation/quality-measurement systems, such as regression detection or quality metrics, or the desire to learn.
  • Solid grounding in observability practices: structured logging, metrics, and using them to debug distributed systems in production.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted dev tools (e.g. agents for code generation, review, debugging), applied with deliberate direction and critical thinking.

Desired:

  • Experience with Go and/or Python.
  • Experience with event-streaming systems (e.g. Kafka).
  • Experience building LLM-backed products.
  • Practical experience applying ML, e.g. building, evaluating, or productionizing models.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior People Technology Analyst - Talent Acquisition

About the job

This position is needed to gather requirements, design solutions, test functionalities, and provide configuration support across the recruit-to-hire employee lifecycle.The successful candidate will partner closely with Talent Acquisition (TA), People Technology, and business stakeholders to design and optimize technology solutions anchored around Greenhouse. While Greenhouse serves as the primary system of record for global hiring, the role will also oversee connected tools within the recruit-to-hire lifecycle, including Workday, Eightfold, HackerRank, LinkedIn, HireRight, and specialized candidate fraud and sourcing platforms.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Participate in requirements gathering sessions with TA and HR stakeholders to understand business processes and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Lead follow-up requirements gathering clarification and demos to stakeholders to ensure recruit-to-hire business outcomes are being achieved.
  • Analyze existing talent acquisition systems and workflows to identify areas for improvement, optimization, and fraud prevention.
  • Work closely with vendors and internal teams to configure, design, and implement solutions across TA platforms including Workday, Eightfold, Greenhouse, LinkedIn, HireRight, and HackerRank.
  • Develop detailed functional design documents and use cases tailored to candidate sourcing, screening, and onboarding.
  • Define test strategies, author comprehensive UAT (User Acceptance Testing) scripts, coordinate testing cycles with recruiters, and hands-on log/triage defects.
  • Manage and execute testing activities including system, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure quality delivery across the hiring tech stack.
  • Provide post-implementation support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement recommendations for all TA applications.
  • Serve as the liaison between TA business units and People Technology Product Managers or Owners, ensuring that technology solutions meet complex hiring needs.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of recruitment technologies, sourcing tools, and industry best practices to inform system enhancements.
  • Create user guides, release notes, and documentation for new features, facilitating training and knowledge transfer sessions for TA users and administrators as needed.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Human Resources, or related field; Master’s preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in HR technology/business systems analysis with a heavy focus on Talent Acquisition applications.
  • Proven expertise and experience supporting core recruitment systems such as Eightfold, Greenhouse, Workday, HackerRank, LinkedIn, HireRight, and candidate fraud platforms.
  • Strong expertise in the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including standard business analysis methodologies, requirements gathering, data modeling, process mapping, UAT execution, and documentation.
  • Experience working with internal and external audit teams and understanding of SOX controls to support recurring audit requests and walkthroughs.
  • Experience with configuration, testing, and implementation of HR technology systems.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of interfacing effectively with both technical and non-technical TA stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Deep knowledge of HR processes strictly related to recruitment, candidate lifecycle management, sourcing strategies, and pre-hire compliance. 

Desired:

  • 5+ years of experience in HR technology/business systems analysis with a heavy focus on Talent Acquisition applications.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment using tools like Jira or Confluence, and ServiceNow.
  • Experience with data analytics and reporting tools specifically related to talent acquisition systems.

This role will be remote and based in the East Coast, USA.

Join the team as our next Strategic Account Executive

About the job

Reporting to the Senior Strategic Account Executive, SEA, this position is needed to manage relationships with some of our largest current Communications platform customers who consume our messaging, voice and email services. You will be directly responsible for protecting and growing Twilio’s communications business across your assigned customers with a focus on South East Asia or South Asia enterprises. As a Strategic Account Executive, you will drive highly analytical and consultative sales cycles (upsell and cross sell) with customers that are running large scale, global, competitively sourced, compliance-heavy, use case-specific businesses. This role is cross functional dependent, and your success will depend on building deep partnerships across product management, finance, support, and operations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Manage and expand some of our most important customer accounts, including high growth technology, retail, eCommerce, Insurance and fintech companies.
  • Develop, drive, and execute account strategy to consistently deliver strong revenue, gross margin, and gross profit results.
  • Partner closely with other Twilio teams to identify new revenue opportunities within your account portfolio.
  • Serve on a cross-functional account team with representatives from product, finance, support, and services teams.
  • Run a disciplined forecast, consistently achieve goals, and present guidance to executive management.
  • Run highly consultative sales cycles with our largest customers with a focus on deep discovery, listening to customer needs and being an effective champion for their point of view in the organization

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

 

*Required:

    • More than 10 years of combined experience in major account or strategic sales, managing or leading quantitative, highly analytical products and solutions for customers. 
    • Experience in supporting South East Asia or South Asia territories.
    • Accountable for relationship management, cross sells, upsells and solutions consulting.
    • Comfortable working with business and highly technical leaders, while influencing their understanding and building supportive partnerships.
    • Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value.
    • Demonstrated track record of managing business forecasts and financial models with use of MEDDPICC.
    • Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite to define processes and build programs.
    • Proven track record of developing, growing and delivering revenue & gross profit results, especially for large-scale and enterprise customers in Asia.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience.

Desired:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • CDP & CPaaS experience is highly desirable
  • Experience selling SaaS/CPaaS/CDP solution selling to a technical and business audience
  • An understanding of the customer experience (CDP + CPaaS) business model
  • Experience managing high tech South East Asia enterprises

 

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Singapore

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 30% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer, Platform Access (L2).

 

About the job

This position is an engineering role within Twilio’s Cloud Native Foundations Team, suited to an engineer focused on identity, governance, and automated access control across multi-cloud environments.

Our team manages identity federation, least-privilege access, and automated provisioning for hundreds of accounts across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). As an L2 engineer, you will help design, build, and operate access controls and platform security tools at scale. You'll get hands-on with multi-cloud IAM, contribute to Terraform-based infrastructure automation, and write code to ensure secure, seamless developer access—using modern AI-assisted tooling to move faster and ramp up your skills.



Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER'S SHOES: Help design, build, and operate automations and access tools that streamline developer workflows while keeping multi-cloud environments secure. Work with security and technical leadership to turn well-scoped tasks into working code.
  • BE AN OWNER (CODE QUALITY): Participate in code reviews and follow established patterns, testing standards and policy-as-code frameworks across the platform.
  • BE AN OWNER (INFRASTRUCTURE & OBSERVABILITY): Support multi-cloud access infrastructure spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP accounts using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Help maintain least-privilege IAM policies, identity federation, role provisioning, and automated lifecycle workflows across hundreds of cloud accounts. Help maintain observability coverage, including metrics, alerts, and basic distributed tracing, across core data pipelines.
  • CHAMPION ENGINEERING HEALTH: Build awareness of secure architectural practices and IAM best practices. Flag access drift, technical debt, security vulnerabilities, and platform issues to your team as you encounter them.
  • GROW AND COLLABORATE: Actively seek feedback and mentorship from senior engineers, participate in sprint planning, and share what you learn with peers as you grow into a more senior role.

General familiarity with multi-account/multi-project cloud architecture is a plus.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer, Platform Engineering (L2)

 

About the job

This position is an engineering role within Twilio Platform Engineering, suited to an engineer who is building hands-on experience with highly available, large-scale distributed systems.

 

Our systems regularly process more than 12 billion emails during peak events like Black Friday, and our throughput requirements continue to scale rapidly. As an L2 engineer, you will help build and operate backend services at scale, working alongside more senior engineers on our dual-cloud infrastructure spanning Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure. You'll get hands-on with Kubernetes, contribute to Terraform-based infrastructure automation, and write production code to help keep distributed systems healthy under real production load, using modern AI-assisted tooling to move faster and ramp up your skills.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER'S SHOES: Help design, build, and operate services and automations that support Kubernetes clusters at scale, under the guidance of senior engineers. Work with product management and technical leadership to turn well-scoped tasks into working code.
  • BE AN OWNER (CODE QUALITY): Participate in code reviews and follow established patterns and testing standards (unit and integration testing) across the team and platform.
  • BE AN OWNER (INFRASTRUCTURE & OBSERVABILITY): Support cloud configurations across AWS and Azure environments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Help maintain observability coverage, including metrics, alerts, and basic distributed tracing, across core data pipelines.
  • CHAMPION ENGINEERING HEALTH: Build awareness of clean architectural practices. Flag technical debt, bugs, and small-scale system issues to your team as you encounter them.
  • GROW AND COLLABORATE: Actively seek feedback and mentorship from senior engineers, participate in sprint planning, and share what you learn with peers as you grow into a more senior role.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Experience: 1-2+ years of professional software engineering experience, including some exposure to building or operating backend services using Kubernetes. Familiarity with basic Kubernetes operations (deployments, pods, services) is expected; deep production-scale cluster-upgrade experience is not required.
  • Modern Development Workflow: Practical experience with, or strong desire to learn, AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) to help write code, automate testing, and support debugging workflows.
  • Deployment Orchestration: Some exposure to GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Harness or an equivalent platform); willingness to learn our specific tooling on the job.
  • Language Proficiency: Working knowledge of at least one of Shell, Terraform, YAML, or Go (Golang), with a willingness to build proficiency across the rest.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Some experience with cloud environments, ideally basic exposure to AWS core services (such as EC2, S3, EKS) or their Microsoft Azure equivalents (such as Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, AKS). General familiarity with networking concepts (VPC/VNet basics) is a plus.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Basic familiarity with Terraform or similar IaC tools.
  • Distributed Systems: Foundational understanding of distributed datastores, caching layers, or asynchronous event streaming (e.g., Kafka or similar queuing systems), through coursework, projects, or professional experience.
  • Systems Mindset: Solid computer science fundamentals and data structures knowledge, with an eagerness to learn how to build self-healing cloud architectures.

Desired:

  • Some exposure to containerized infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes) in coursework, internships, or professional projects.
  • Curiosity about advanced deployment strategies (canary, blue/green); prior hands-on experience not required.
  • Interest in policy-as-code tools such as OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Interest in OpenTelemetry or distributed tracing concepts.
  • Any exposure to network topology, proxy layers, or mail transfer agent (MTA) protocols.
  • Coursework or personal projects involving distributed datastores, caching, or event streaming (e.g., Kafka).
  • Interest in multi-cloud environments and a desire to build that experience over time.

As a Software Engineer on this team you will participate in all phases of the software development life cycle which includes requirements gathering with Product Managers, technical design, estimations, sprint planning, coding, testing, deployments and on-call support. This engineer will own, operate and maintain their teams’ services in a distributed production environment, employing Agile methodologies to continuously deliver value to customers.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be an owner: Design and implement real-time services with high throughput and low latency requirements, verify, deploy and operationalize them
  • Wear the customer's shoes: Work closely with stakeholders to understand customer needs and, devise and deliver, simple, robust and scalable solutions
  • Write it down: Be comfortable expressing thoughts and ideas as detailed prose and use it as an effective means to collaborate with leads, architects and cross functional teams
  • Be bold: Embrace the challenge of scaling a complex distributed platform with points of presence globally, each one concerned with high availability, high reliability, high throughput, low latency, and media fidelity

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Global Business Services’ (GBS) primary goal is to ensure operational excellence across deal cycles, increase revenue through the development of transformative commercial constructs, and drive closure of Stripe’s deal portfolio. The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region; GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users and cross-functional teams. GBS’s priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations, as well as user feedback and market insights.

What you’ll do

Stripe's Global Business Services (GBS) team is looking for a Deal Strategist to play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and commercial operation. In this strategic position, you will be a key partner to our go-to-market teams, providing expert guidance, recommendations, and influence on deal structuring, pricing, and commercial strategy to support strategic decision-making across the region. You will be responsible for deal lifecycle management and supporting cross-organizational alignment. This role requires a background in driving custom commercial and pricing deals to closure, a strong understanding of private pricing frameworks, and experience supporting sales through complex negotiations.

The candidate will have experience with subscription, usage-based revenue and hybrid pricing models, pricing strategies, and a background in supporting selling motions. The candidate will have strong communication skills and a passion for applying emerging technology to drive efficiency. You will love this job if you are a natural relationship and mechanism builder who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

Responsibilities

  • Support sellers with their deals end-to-end, this includes structuring, coaching, pricing, drafting, editing, managing xfn collaboration and approvals. Reviewing agreements while supporting the sales cycle to ensure deal terms align with business goals, reflect strategic priorities, and close as forecasted.
  • Coach sellers on constructing strategically defensible opening commercial positions that preserve room to negotiate without conceding value, planning for typical deal iteration cycles and the commercial flexibility needed to maintain competitive terms through to close.
  • Lead contact between Sales, Commercial Legal, Risk, Monetization Ops, and other cross-functional stakeholders for deal-related queries, approvals, and escalations.
  • Work directly with sales teams, sales leaders, services/support teams and customers to advise on deal structures, establish compelling commercials, and drive closure of customer issues.
  • Understand the business and technical requirements of our customers and partners, advising sales teams on the best approach (balancing risk between custom terms and internal system limitations).
  • Remove internal blockers and drive solutions between cross-functional teams such as Product, Legal, Finance, Accounting, Service Teams, etc.
  • Support complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial and legal agreements.
  • Support the pricing and structuring of multithreaded product use cases in all segments and industries especially in highly competitive sales.
  • Lead program ownership for New Product Initiatives (NPI), including the creation of new commercial constructs, pricing bundles, and packages to support product go-to-market strategies.
  • Partner cross-functionally on the design, build, and launch of seller systems and tooling, including CPQ design and configuration, contract management platforms, and commercial workflow automation to support scalable deal operations.
  • Quickly build credibility and trust with internal customers.
  • Provide strong support, communication, and persuasion skills including XFN and senior leaders.
  • Establish strong relationships with APAC regional go-to-market stakeholders to drive commercial alignment and operational excellence.
  • Train and enable Sales teams on pricing, quoting, and contract best practices, internal approvals to accelerate deal cycles and maximize business outcomes.
  • Deliver clear, concise, and insightful commercial analyses, deal recommendations, and executive-level reports to stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Champion AI fluency and actively apply emerging technology tools to drive day-to-day efficiency in deal workflows and operations.

  • Experience working in ambiguous, quickly scaling environments, comfortable with high-agency.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and program management skills.
  • Experience working in Payments and/or SaaS.
  • Experience in Salesforce and Ironclad.
  • Experience managing redline agreements.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with subscription and usage-based revenue models.
  • In-depth knowledge of regional market regulations and business practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in AI, or related technology sectors.

  • Track record of scaling deals or commercial operations in rapidly growing organizations.

job_title: Member of Technical Staff (AI Policy and Strategic Initiatives)
description:
Perplexity is seeking an intrepid Member of Technical Staff to take on one of the AI industry's most unique engineering roles. You'll work directly with Perplexity's senior leadership to spearhead a broad portfolio of strategic technology initiatives across policy, law, operations, and corporate affairs.
 As a Member of Technical Staff in the Policy & Strategic Initiatives group, you'll occupy a front-row seat to the foremost policy issues animating the AI ecosystem. You'll also get a panoptic view of how leading AI companies operate, make decisions, and engage with broader society.
 Those seeking to marry technical expertise and broader interests in law, policy, and corporate affairs will find a home in this role. You'll make contributions to Perplexity that defy traditional boundaries, with a bench of mentors who will push you to learn and grow day after day.
 
 
 What you'll do:
 Your work will be both highly interdisciplinary and firmly grounded in engineering rigor. On any given day, you might:
 Harness AI agents to research high-stakes policy and regulatory issues pertaining to Perplexity.

 Build automated platforms for harvesting, prioritizing, and patenting Perplexity's inventions, in collaboration with our AI researchers and intellectual property attorneys.

 Work hands-on with our Legal team and outside counsel in support of high-tech litigation matters in U.S. federal court.

 Engineer privacy and compliance systems that efficiently scale with our growing portfolio of frontier AI products (such as Comet and Computer ).

 Contribute to regulatory filings and responses that require impeccable command of AI technology, Perplexity's own systems, and the broader policy landscape.

 Embed with our People team to implement first-party software solutions for recruiting, labor compliance, and performance management.

 Participate in meetings with Capitol Hill, executive branch officials, international partners, and civil society as a subject-matter expert on both AI technology and policy.

 The above is a small sampling of activities; no two days will be the same, and your work will take you to all corners of our company. You'll interact each day with Perplexity's senior leaders, who will come to rely on you as a creative problem solver for simple and complex matters alike.
 
 Who we're looking for:
 No single profile defines our ideal candidate for this role. Here are some examples of people who might thrive here:
 Exceptionally talented early-career engineers (new grads welcome) who are (1) well-read in law, tech policy, or economics, and (2) wish to grow in both technical and non-technical disciplines.
 We welcome candidates who plan to attend law school or PhD programs in the future; we ask for a minimum 2-year commitment (i.e., you would apply for the entering class of 2028 or later).

 
 Experienced engineers at top tech companies who wish to develop policy, business, and operations chops.

 Lawyers or economists (new JD or PhD grads welcome) who've kept their engineering skills sharp and are excited to reimagine their fields in the age of AI.

 This is a non-exhaustive list; other profiles may also be great fits.

 No matter which profile describes you, we'll also be looking for:
 Evidence of exceptional ability and 99th-percentile work ethic.

 Strong technical skills at or above Perplexity's hiring bar for software engineers.

 Fluency with frontier intelligence tools (such as Perplexity Computer ).

 High intrinsically-enforced standards for the craft and quality of your work.

 Strong communication and writing skills, ideally demonstrated via samples of past written work product.

 Curiosity and excitement about new and unfamiliar fields; eagerness to redefine your job every 3-6 months.

 Ability to quickly dive deep in any given field and develop mastery rivaling that of domain experts.

 Unimpeachable judgment, integrity, and discretion to be entrusted with the company's most important matters.

 A service-oriented attitude that continually questions how company systems and processes might better serve stakeholders.

job_title: Member of Technical Staff (Secure Intelligence Institute)
description:
Perplexity is seeking energetic researchers and engineers to join our Secure Intelligence Institute (SII), Perplexity's flagship research center for advancing security, privacy, and trust in frontier intelligence. SII’s goals are to advance frontier AI security research, translate those advances into concrete improvements in Perplexity's systems, and share knowledge and resources that strengthen the broader AI ecosystem.
 As a member of SII, you'll conduct original and impactful research on improving the security and privacy of frontier intelligence systems. Your goal will be to conduct research that is not only rigorous in theory, but practical enough to improve the systems people rely on every day. This work will be informed by the realities of operating general-purpose AI systems used by millions of people and thousands of enterprises, and you'll be expected to translate both your own research and advances from the broader community to practical improvements that protect and defend Perplexity's users.
 
 Responsibilities
 Develop threat models for emerging attack surfaces in AI-native products, including browser, search, and autonomous agents.

 Identify and analyze security and privacy threats across AI systems, infrastructure, and user-facing products.

 Develop novel defenses, mitigations, and detection mechanisms for security and privacy in AI-native products.

 Build security evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and datasets to measure the effectiveness of different defense mechanisms.

 Partner with Perplexity’s Security Engineering team to translate state of the art research into shipped security features and hardened system architectures.

 Collaborate with top-tier academic and industry researchers in SII's external research network.

 Publish findings at premier venues and contribute to the broader security research community.

 
 Qualifications
 Hold a PhD (or equivalent research experience) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with a primary focus on security and/or privacy.

 Experience publishing at top security conferences (IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, ACM CCS, NDSS) demonstrating original, impactful research contributions.

 Deep expertise in one or more of: security of agentic systems, systems security, web and applications security, program analysis, and software security.

 Proficiency in Python (bonus points for TypeScript, Go, and/or Rust).

 Ability to operate with high independence, willing to dive in and take ownership, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment where research directly informs product.

 Clear and concise communcation, translating complex attack narratives into actionable insights for engineering and leadership.

job_title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, API Platform)
description:
Perplexity API Platform
 Perplexity innovates at the frontier of AI infrastructure, search, and orchestration to serve the world's most discerning users. The Perplexity API Platform brings our technology to the world's most discerning developers. From exabyte-scale knowledge indexes to codegen-first agent runtimes, the building blocks behind Perplexity's applications are some of the most battle-tested AI systems in the industry.
 We believe these same building blocks can and should power the aspirations of builders everywhere. It's one thing to solve planet-scale retrieval, long-horizon orchestration, and other foundational AI challenges within a single product ecosystem. The true measure of success is to turn those solutions into elegant APIs that delight developers and agents alike. Our API Platform delivers frontier intelligence to thousands of customers: startups, trillion-dollar enterprises, U.S. and allied governments, and everyone in between.
 We've achieved incredible scale, yet we're just getting started. Join us to build tools for curious minds.
 
 About this role
 Perplexity is seeking strong engineers with a passion for delivering frontier intelligence and infrastructure to developers. Our company builds technology that reshapes how people search, reason, and interact with the world around them. Week after week, we observe increasing demand for programmatic interfaces to that technology. The API Platform engineering team is charged with designing, implementing, and scaling these interfaces.
 As a member of our team, you'll work on an eclectic portfolio spanning distributed systems, performance optimization, agent orchestration, and frontier topics that often change with each passing month. Throughout this work, you'll prioritize great developer and agent experience alike. You'll also define technical strategy for how we scale to meet compounding growth exponentials (number of customers, agents per customer, compute/retrieval per agent, etc.).
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, build, and operate mission-critical APIs that provide our customers the building blocks for frontier intelligence.

 Own and evolve the API gateway and routing layer: authentication, authorization, rate limiting and quotas, usage metering, and request routing across heterogeneous upstream services.

 Build the paved road for API services: standardized service scaffolding, container builds, CI/CD, Kubernetes and Helm deployment, and progressive rollouts with fast rollback, so a new API product goes from idea to production in days, not weeks.

 Build API governance into the platform: contract-first schemas, breaking-change detection in CI, versioning and deprecation workflows, and SDKs and documentation generated from a single source of truth.

 Unify cross-cutting capabilities (billing and usage, rate limiting, organization and identity settings, analytics and observability) so every API product gets them by default instead of rebuilding them.

 Ensure low latency and high throughput through aggressive performance optimization (including on upstream systems).

 Harden system security and reliability across heterogeneous compute environments, and operate what you build: SLOs, on-call, and incident response.

 Collaborate across teams to bring novel frontier capabilities into the API Platform, and partner with infrastructure teams on compute, networking, secrets, and security.

 Continually reimagine the customer needs of tomorrow (and the architectures to serve those needs), while faithfully serving the customer workloads of today.

 Uphold engineering excellence through design reviews, code quality, and internal documentation.

 
 Qualifications 
 5+ years of backend engineering experience with Python, Go, or Rust, including significant time building platforms or infrastructure used by other engineering teams.

 Strong understanding of high-traffic API design: schema evolution & versioning, idempotency, authentication patterns, rate limiting, and performance tuning.

 Hands-on experience building and operating API gateways, reverse proxies, or routing layers: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, request routing, traffic shaping, and per-request observability.

 Experience building API governance tooling: contract-first API design, breaking-change detection and API linting in CI, versioning and deprecation workflows, and SDKs and documentation generated from the contract.

 Platform depth across the build and deploy path: you have owned CI/CD pipelines, container builds and base images, infrastructure as code, and progressive delivery (canary or blue-green) on a major cloud.

 A track record of owning a platform end to end: identifying the need, designing it, aligning the teams that depend on it, shipping it, and operating it, while raising the engineering bar for the teams building on it.

 Strong customer empathy and product sense, ensuring the APIs you build are ergonomic, well-documented, and easy to adopt for developers and agents alike.

 Strong plus:
 Experience with modern AI APIs (including latency tuning, streaming, model orchestration, emerging technical standards).

 Usage-based billing and metering systems, multi-tenant organization and identity models, and usage analytics pipelines.

 Observability for API platforms: structured logging pipelines, metrics, tracing, and SLO tooling.

job_title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Acceleration)
description:
About the Role
 The AI Acceleration team’s mission is to make Perplexity the best place to build and ship software with AI agents. We build the infrastructure that engineers and agents rely on, and develop new ways for agents to write, test, review, and ship code. Our work helps teams move from an idea to production faster, without compromising quality or reliability.
 
 We own the end-to-end development experience at Perplexity, from the environment where code is written to the systems that ship it to production. That includes local and cloud coding environments, build and test infrastructure, code review, and release management. We’re also building autonomous software development systems, where agents take on increasingly complex engineering work with explicit evaluation, verification, and safety controls. We own both the infrastructure these systems depend on and the workflows that make them useful.
 
 As an AI Acceleration Engineer, you’ll turn emerging agent capabilities into dependable systems used across Perplexity. You’ll work directly with engineers to understand where development slows down, experiment with new approaches, and take promising ideas through to production. This role combines systems engineering, developer experience, and hands-on agent development, with a direct measure of success: helping teams spend less time on delivery overhead and more time building products.
 
 Responsibilities 
 Identify, prioritize, and deliver the highest-impact opportunities to accelerate how Perplexity builds and ships software with AI.

 Work directly with engineering and business teams to understand their workflows, constraints, and bottlenecks, and build solutions that address how they actually work.

 Build and operate the infrastructure that engineers and agents depend on, including development environments, build and test systems, code review, and release tooling.

 Make our codebases, systems, and internal knowledge easier for agents to navigate, understand, and use through better tooling, interfaces, documentation, and context.

 Take agent-driven workflows from prototype to production, building the evaluations, verification, and controls needed to delegate increasingly complex engineering work safely.

 Improve delivery speed and software quality together. Measure the impact of your work on development time, review effort, and production reliability, and use those results to guide what comes next.

 Evaluate emerging models, tools, and approaches through hands-on experimentation. Turn the evidence into clear technical decisions, and drive adoption of the technologies that prove useful.

 Use AI extensively in your own engineering work, share what works, and help colleagues adopt effective practices. Partner with engineering leadership and recruiting to strengthen how we hire and develop engineers who work effectively with AI.

 
 Qualifications 
 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with substantial work in infrastructure, platform engineering, or developer productivity in technically complex environments.

 Daily, hands-on use of AI models and coding tools, with practical judgment about where they perform well, where they fail, and how to verify their output.

 Strong proficiency in one of the languages – Python, Go or Rust, along with the willingness to learn other languages as the work requires.

 Broad familiarity with the systems used by AI product and applied research teams, including cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, data pipelines, and ML tooling. You don’t need deep expertise in every layer, but you should understand how they fit together.

 An ability to understand how engineers and researchers across disciplines work, paired with curiosity about the needs of business and operations teams. You build tools around users’ actual workflows and constraints.

 A drive to make codebases, systems, and processes easier to understand, operate, and change. You look for ways to replace brittle workflows and implicit knowledge with clear interfaces and reliable automation.

 Sound technical judgment about when to experiment, when to commit, and when to ship a pragmatic solution. You can balance immediate delivery with investments that make future work faster and more reliable.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Global Payments Experiences group is an organization focused on bringing new and novel payment methods to Stripe, and ensuring Stripe’s systems work well for merchants globally. This team works with internal and external partners to expand regional, non-card payment options, and to expand the use of Stripe’s payments processing globally.

What you’ll do

This is a Sao Paulo-based team, with platform teams in the US and Europe and sister teams worldwide. This team in particular will build and maintain new payment methods for Stripe, with a focus on LATAM and North America. They will manage local market idiosyncrasies, become regional experts that other Stripe teams will rely on, and partner with many non-tech functions at Stripe to expand our global reach and product portfolio. 

Responsibilities

  • Design and reason about integration experiences with a strong focus on end-user simplicity and developer experience
  • Build back-end services and integrations across solutions across Stripe’s payments product
  • Engage and interact with external partners to determine and build technical solutions
  • Engage directly with users to understand their business needs and translate requirements into concrete solutions
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, partnerships, eng platforms, and other engineering teams to deliver these solutions
  • Contribute to software platforms used across payments at Stripe

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2+ years of backend engineering experience
  • Strong command of verbal and written English language
  • Experience working across geographies
  • Experience building extensible, leveraged software solutions that scale to different kinds of user needs, with the ability to empathize with users and advocate for exceptional user experiences

Preferred qualifications

  • Previous experiences working in payments and on payments technology
  • Previous experience using Stripe products

We're hiring a Procurement Lead to build Perplexity's procurement function. You'll design how Perplexity buys, from the workflow and policies teams follow to the agreements we sign and the vendor relationships we manage after signature. You'll be a key partner to teams across the company, helping them choose the right vendors and structure strong agreements without becoming a bottleneck, and making sure every dollar we commit to third parties earns its keep.
 
 This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and wants to build the function, not inherit one, with room for your scope to grow as the company does. We value someone who can set direction, dig into the details, and follow through. This position is based in San Francisco and requires in-person attendance 2-3 days per week.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Lead our highest-impact vendor deals across software, cloud services, data, and professional services, from competitive alternatives through pricing, terms, and signature

 Structure committed-spend, usage-based, and multi-year agreements that scale with our usage and preserve our flexibility

 Own relationships with our most important vendors, including performance tracking, business reviews, and renewal negotiations

 Design an efficient procurement workflow, policies, and approval thresholds, and implement the tools and AI automation to run them

 Use AI workflows and agents to automate procurement, from intake and contract review to spend analysis and reporting

 Build visibility into vendor spend and contracts, and drive savings through consolidation, right-sizing, and renegotiation

 Partner with Legal, Security, and Accounting on contract terms, vendor risk reviews, and audit-ready controls

 What You'll Bring
 5-7+ years of experience in procurement or strategic sourcing at a high-growth technology company, including building or scaling the function.

 A track record of personally negotiating multi-million dollar software, cloud, or data agreements, managing those vendors and renegotiating at renewal, and delivering measurable savings

 Experience building procurement processes, policies, and systems from scratch

 Ability to run multiple deals at once with incomplete information, and sound judgment about when to move fast and when to escalate

 Comfort using AI tools to accelerate your work and improve workflows

 A low-ego, roll-up-your-sleeves approach to projects large and small and to working across the organization

 Strong communication skills, the ability to influence senior leaders, and a reputation for being commercially tough and fair

Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.
 We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.
 We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.
 As a Finance Intern you'll do real work from day one, alongside a team that came from top banks, funds and startups. This isn't a back-office finance team: we sit right next to the business, across operations, deals and everything in between. You'll get rare ownership and exposure for an internship, and a real chance to earn a full-time seat. The internship runs as two tracks: Business Operations or Corporate Finance.
 
 Responsibilities 

 Cost: Take ownership of daily invoice reconciliations, investigating discrepancies, understanding the drivers behind business expenditure and benchmarking costs to ensure the business is securing the best possible deals. Identify opportunities to reduce costs, improve commercial terms and drive greater efficiency across the business. Alongside this, contribute to wider projects focused on cost optimisation, working closely with the strategy, M&A and finance systems teams. Take a proactive and creative approach to problem-solving, thinking outside the box and taking ownership of challenges and opportunities as they arise.
 Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Take ownership of daily bank reconciliations, matching invoices against the general ledger to ensure accuracy and consistency across financial records. job_title: Staff Product Manager, Metering and Attribution
description:
Revenue Engineering builds the platform that measures how customers use Datadog and turns that measurement into usage and cost data they can act on. Every product Datadog ships is metered here. Every customer who wants to see which team, service, or business unit drove their usage sees it through this layer.

As a Staff Product Manager for Metering and Cost Attribution, you will own product direction for that platform. You will set the standard for how usage is measured, attributed, and presented across Datadog.

The role starts with tagging: the mechanism customers use to attribute usage to owners inside their organization, and the foundation that cost allocation, chargeback, quotas, and governance build on. From there you will shape the metering capabilities that new pricing and packaging models draw on, and extend the platform's speed and scale as Datadog's portfolio grows. Over time you will own the vision and roadmap for a usage platform used by every team at Datadog and relied on by every customer.

The usage layer is the system of record for consumption, and it is what billing draws from. What you own is the path from usage events to billable output, along with the consumption models, cost attribution, and usage analytics that customers and their finance teams use to understand their spend. You will partner closely with the billing platform team across that boundary.

Usage and cost attribution reach across a broad portfolio of billable metrics, several regions, and customers organized into parent and child organizations and reseller hierarchies, and they surface in units and in dollars, in-app, through the API, and in agentic workflows. Designing for that range means making deliberate choices about granularity, timeliness, and flexibility, and holding those choices steady across the many teams that build on them.

This is a highly visible individual contributor role spanning several engineering teams, every product vertical that emits billable telemetry, and partners in Sales, Support, and Finance.

What You'll Do:

  • Set product direction for metering and attribution by defining the problems and outcomes that matter from usage events through billable output, holding a multi-quarter view of how the platform should evolve, and collaborating with multiple engineering teams to sequence work into phases that deliver clear customer value along the way.
  • Own the tagging model as a customer-facing product, giving customers a consistent way to define tags across every product, translating those tags into granular usage and cost breakdowns wherever they surface, and designing how customers adjust and reconstruct attribution when their tagging changes.

description:

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. The Developer Infrastructure org is the engine behind Robinhood's entire engineering organization — a collection of tightly integrated teams whose collective mission is to make every engineer at Robinhood faster, more reliable, and exponentially more productive. The org spans four major teams: DevX (Developer Experience), TestX (Test Infrastructure), Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform. DevX owns Robinhood's monorepo and Bazel-based build infrastructure — the critical layer between a developer writing code and that code being ready to ship — along with the company's full CI/CD pipeline and remote build execution cluster. TestX owns the infrastructure behind Robinhood's entire test experience: the integration test environments, and personal development environments that serve as miniature simulations of the full Robinhood system, giving engineers a safe, isolated space to test their code end-to-end before it ever touches production. Backend Platform and Mobile Platform own the core language runtimes, libraries, IDEs, and developer toolchains across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android. Together, these teams share a single north star: leveraging AI and agentic systems to fundamentally transform Robinhood's software development lifecycle — making every engineer dramatically more productive and the entire org a force multiplier for the business.

As the Senior Staff Software Developer, Developer Infrastructure, you are the technical driver of this entire org — the Uber Tech Lead unifying DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform under one cohesive technical vision. Your primary focus will be DevX, owning the technical direction of Robinhood's most critical build and developer infrastructure. But your influence stretches far wider: you will be a driving force in weaving AI and agentic development deeply into every layer of the software development lifecycle — from intelligent code review and automated build pipelines to agentic coding systems that multiply what each engineer can ship. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just how Robinhood builds software today, but what engineering velocity looks like for the entire industry!

This role is based in our Toronto office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

  • Scale CI/CD pipelines to support thousands of daily builds with speed, safety, and reliability — overseeing GitHub repository configurations, pre-merge checks, and test execution infrastructure across the company
  • Drive the vision for TestX — the test infrastructure and environments that power Robinhood's entire test experience, including integration test environments and personal development environments that simulate the full Robinhood system so engineers can test safely and confidently
  • Champion the integration of AI and agentic systems across the full software development lifecycle — driving initiatives that use intelligent automation and coding agents to multiply developer velocity, improve code quality, and accelerate the pace of innovation across the org
  • Set technical standards across Backend Platform and Mobile Platform — owning the vision for core language runtimes, libraries, IDE tooling, and developer environment security across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to define and execute a long-term developer infrastructure roadmap that embeds AI as a force multiplier at every layer of the SDLC

  • Deep expertise with Bazel and large-scale monorepo build systems — you've owned remote build execution infrastructure at scale and understand the architectural tradeoffs deeply
  • Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines at massive scale — across thousands of daily builds, multiple programming languages, and complex pre-merge pipeline logic

  • Strong background with distributed systems, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) — you understand the full stack of developer tooling from IDE to deployment
  • Experience with test infrastructure, integration test environments, or developer environment platforms — you understand what a great test experience looks like at scale
  • Genuine interest in or hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, automated code review, or AI-driven developer velocity programs — you have a clear point of view on how AI will reshape the software development lifecycle and want to be the one building it
  • Exceptional technical leadership, communication, and influence skills — you've unified cross-functional engineering teams around a shared vision and driven ambiguous, org-spanning initiatives to completion
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating the technical bar across large, diverse engineering organizations

description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Developer Infrastructure org is the engine behind Robinhood's entire engineering organization — a collection of tightly integrated teams whose collective mission is to make every engineer at Robinhood faster, more reliable, and exponentially more productive. The org spans four major teams: DevX (Developer Experience), TestX (Test Infrastructure), Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform. DevX owns Robinhood's monorepo and Bazel-based build infrastructure — the critical layer between a developer writing code and that code being ready to ship — along with the company's full CI/CD pipeline and remote build execution cluster. TestX owns the infrastructure behind Robinhood's entire test experience: the integration test environments, and personal development environments that serve as miniature simulations of the full Robinhood system, giving engineers a safe, isolated space to test their code end-to-end before it ever touches production. Backend Platform and Mobile Platform own the core language runtimes, libraries, IDEs, and developer toolchains across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android. Together, these teams share a single north star: leveraging AI and agentic systems to fundamentally transform Robinhood's software development lifecycle — making every engineer dramatically more productive and the entire org a force multiplier for the business.

As the Senior Staff Software Engineer, Developer Infrastructure, you are the technical driver of this entire org — the Uber Tech Lead unifying DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform under one cohesive technical vision. Your primary focus will be DevX, owning the technical direction of Robinhood's most critical build and developer infrastructure. But your influence stretches far wider: you will be a driving force in weaving AI and agentic development deeply into every layer of the software development lifecycle — from intelligent code review and automated build pipelines to agentic coding systems that multiply what each engineer can ship. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just how Robinhood builds software today, but what engineering velocity looks like for the entire industry!

This role is based in our New York City or Menlo Park office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own the technical direction and roadmap for the Developer Infrastructure org — serving as the Uber Tech Lead across DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform, unifying four engineering teams under a shared technical vision
  • Lead and evolve Robinhood's Bazel-based monorepo build infrastructure — own the remote build execution cluster, drive language-agnostic build optimization across Python, Go, TypeScript, and more, and ensure fast, stable feedback loops for the entire engineering org
  • Scale CI/CD pipelines to support thousands of daily builds with speed, safety, and reliability — overseeing GitHub repository configurations, pre-merge checks, and test execution infrastructure across the company
  • Drive the vision for TestX — the test infrastructure and environments that power Robinhood's entire test experience, including integration test environments and personal development environments that simulate the full Robinhood system so engineers can test safely and confidently
  • Champion the integration of AI and agentic systems across the full software development lifecycle — driving initiatives that use intelligent automation and coding agents to multiply developer velocity, improve code quality, and accelerate the pace of innovation across the org
  • Set technical standards across Backend Platform and Mobile Platform — owning the vision for core language runtimes, libraries, IDE tooling, and developer environment security across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to define and execute a long-term developer infrastructure roadmap that embeds AI as a force multiplier at every layer of the SDLC

What you bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record at the Senior Staff, Principal, or Distinguished Engineer level — you've set technical direction at the org or company level, not just the team level
  • Deep expertise with Bazel and large-scale monorepo build systems — you've owned remote build execution infrastructure at scale and understand the architectural tradeoffs deeply
  • Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines at massive scale — across thousands of daily builds, multiple programming languages, and complex pre-merge pipeline logic
  • Fluency in Go and/or Python; broad familiarity with TypeScript, Swift, or Android development environments is a strong signal
  • Strong background with distributed systems, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) — you understand the full stack of developer tooling from IDE to deployment
  • Experience with test infrastructure, integration test environments, or developer environment platforms — you understand what a great test experience looks like at scale
  • Genuine interest in or hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, automated code review, or AI-driven developer velocity programs — you have a clear point of view on how AI will reshape the software development lifecycle and want to be the one building it
  • Exceptional technical leadership, communication, and influence skills — you've unified cross-functional engineering teams around a shared vision and driven ambiguous, org-spanning initiatives to completion
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating the technical bar across large, diverse engineering organizations

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Technical Account Managers are responsible for the technical relationship of Stripe Crypto's largest and most complex users. We lead cross-functional efforts across Engineering, Product, and go-to-market teams—balancing our users' business needs with technical constraints—and act as trusted partners and consultants who help businesses deliver more value to their customers, optimize their technical operations, and accelerate their global growth with Stripe.

What you'll do

As a Technical Account Manager for Crypto, you will own the technical relationship for Stripe's most strategic crypto-native users: high-growth companies building on Stripe's crypto and stablecoin products, including Bridge and Privy. You will be the technical expert your accounts trust and rely on—developing deep relationships with their key stakeholders, mobilizing cross-functional teams across Stripe to resolve their most complex technical challenges, and proactively identifying opportunities that help them succeed and scale.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for a set of strategic crypto accounts; build durable relationships with their Engineering, Payments Operations, and Product stakeholders.
  • Lead complex technical troubleshooting and incident response for assigned accounts; own communications and remediation until resolution, collaborating with Product, Support, and Engineering when needed.
  • Partner closely with GTM and other user-facing teams to deliver a coordinated experience across your accounts, pairing technical ownership with commercial strategy.
  • Translate customer and developer needs into actionable product feedback: aggregate patterns across accounts, size the business impact, surface it to Product and Engineering, and follow through to completion.
  • Develop and maintain account-specific operational runbooks, escalation paths, and success metrics (uptime, latency, transaction throughput, settlement timelines).
  • Proactively review your accounts' implementations to identify improvements and surface potential issues—across areas like performance, reliability, and compliance workflows—before they impact the user's experience, and flag growth opportunities to partner teams.
  • Deliver regular business and technical reviews with customers (quarterly reviews, post-mortems, roadmap previews) and drive action items to closure.
  • Create and maintain user-facing technical documentation, sample code, and troubleshooting guides that reduce friction and enable self-service.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and process improvements that reduce operational friction, improve SLAs, and scale TSC coverage and effectiveness.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years in enterprise-level, client-facing technical roles such as Technical Account Management, Technical Solutions Consulting, or Solutions Engineering.
  • Strong experience with RESTful APIs and webhooks, and the ability to explain API concepts, integration patterns, and troubleshooting steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Working familiarity with stablecoins and blockchain fundamentals, including chains, wallets, on-chain transaction lifecycle, and on/off-ramps, with genuine enthusiasm for going deeper.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills and demonstrated experience partnering with engineering teams to resolve production incidents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and stakeholder management. You can hold both business-level and deeply technical conversations, and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Experience owning complex projects across multiple teams, including timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment and prioritizing between reactive and proactive account work.

Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on experience implementing crypto, stablecoin, or blockchain systems, including blockchain APIs and integrating digital assets with traditional financial systems.
  • Background in payments, fintech, or cross-border money movement, including how traditional rails and stablecoin rails interoperate.
  • Comfort with observability tooling for diagnosing production issues, such as Datadog or a comparable platform for log search, dashboards, monitors, and distributed traces.
  • Experience with tools like Postman and cURL, light scripting in Python or Node.js, basic SQL, and AI coding agents for debugging and root-cause investigation.
  • An operations-savvy mindset, with a track record of removing process friction and replacing one-off workarounds with scalable processes.
  • Strong product sense and comfort translating customer business objectives into technical implementations and product feedback.

About the Role

Datadog’s Technology Partnerships team builds and scales partnerships with the technology companies that matter most to our customers from AI/ML platforms to data platform providers. As a Technology Partner Manager, you will own the full, 360-degree relationship with a portfolio of strategic Technology Partners, with a particular focus on cutting-edge AI/ML and Data Platform companies. You’ll be the connective tissue across three pillars of partnership: co-build (joint product and integration roadmaps), co-market (joint awareness and demand generation), and co-sell (joint pipeline and revenue). This is a highly cross-functional, relationship-driven role that requires equal comfort in a product roadmap discussion, a marketing planning session, and a sales enablement meeting.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do

  • 360° Relationship Ownership: Own the end-to-end partner relationship for a portfolio of AI/ML and Data Platform technology partners, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor across product, engineering, marketing, and sales stakeholders on both sides.
  • Co-Build: Partner closely with Datadog Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and drive joint integration roadmaps; ensure integrations are built, launched, and continuously improved to meet customer needs.
  • Co-Market: Design and execute joint marketing programs including webinars, blog posts, customer case studies, launch campaigns, and event collaboration with Datadog product marketing and partner marketing teams to build awareness and demand for joint solutions.
  • Co-Sell: Build and execute go-to-market and co-sell plans with Datadog channel team, partner field and sales teams; enable Datadog’s global sales organization and partner sellers on joint value propositions, use cases, and co-sell motions to drive pipeline and revenue.
  • Program Management: Track partnership commitments, joint business plans, and success metrics across the co-build, co-market, and co-sell pillars; report regularly to leadership on partnership health, pipeline, and revenue impact.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the connective tissue between partners and internal Datadog teams including Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Channels & Alliances to keep joint initiatives moving and unblock issues quickly.
  • Marketplace & Routes to Market: Ensure Datadog integrations are well-represented in partner marketplaces and directories, and identify new routes to market with partners, including joint listings on cloud and partner marketplaces.
  • Enablement: Create and maintain internal and partner-facing content including playbooks, battlecards, and training  that helps both organizations clearly articulate the joint value proposition.
  • Market Awareness: Track trends across the AI/ML and data platform ecosystems to identify new partnership opportunities and ensure Datadog’s partner strategy stays ahead of a fast-moving market.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field; an MBA is a strong plus.
  • 7+ years of experience in technology partnerships, alliances, partner management, or business development at a software, cloud, or SaaS company.
  • Experience managing the full partnership lifecycle including technical/product collaboration, marketing programs, and sales/co-sell motions 
  • Comfortable working with technical products; able to understand integration architectures and translate them into clear business value for marketing and sales audiences.
  • Familiarity with the AI/ML and/or data platform ecosystem (e.g., LLM providers, vector databases, data warehouses, data pipeline and orchestration tools)

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to create compelling partner-facing and internal enablement materials.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to utilize data to inform and drive strategic partnership decisions.

We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

What you'll do

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.

The team is looking for an online payments specialist with a proven track record of designing checkout experiences and payment flows for B2C and B2B enterprises. You will engage with Stripe's customers as a thought leader in the conversion optimization space, helping them understand how Stripe Link—Stripe's one-click checkout network—can reduce cart abandonment, improve returning customer conversion, and create a more seamless payments experience at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe Link to accelerate opportunities globally
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of checkout optimization, network-based authentication, and the business impact of saved payment methods on conversion
  • Develop expertise with Stripe's Link integration patterns—including embedded checkout, Stripe.js, and direct API flows—and guide customers through key implementation decisions
  • Advise customers on how Link interacts with the broader Stripe platform (Radar, Billing, Connect) to deliver compounding value across their payment stack
  • Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
  • Create reference architectures that help customers visualize end-to-end checkout and conversion improvements
  • Partner closely with the Payments product sales team on Stripe's most strategic Link opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
  • Partner closely with the Link product team to get early exposure to new features
  • Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization
  • Identify and summarize trends in checkout UX, wallets, passkeys, and network-based authentication, and provide actionable insights to product stakeholders and sales
  • Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
  • Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
  • Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows
  • Approximately 25% travel is anticipated

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role focused on online payments or e-commerce
  • Strong working knowledge of checkout optimization, including conversion metrics, cart abandonment, and the UX and technical levers that influence them
  • Familiarity with payment authentication standards (3DS, passkeys, network tokenization) and their impact on authorization rates
  • Experience designing payment flows and integrations for large enterprises, including multi-market and multi-currency scenarios
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications
  • Experience with A/B testing or analytics frameworks for checkout optimization
  • Familiarity with wallet and one-click checkout ecosystems (Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Shop Pay)
  • Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The AI Infrastructure team is building the foundation that powers machine learning and AI across Robinhood. We own the infrastructure supporting the entire ML/AI lifecycle, from feature engineering and training pipelines to model serving, inference, and observability. We also build and operate Robinhood's LLM gateway, enabling engineering teams across the company to leverage frontier and fine-tuned in-house AI models efficiently and at scale.

You'll work across traditional ML infrastructure and emerging LLM technologies, helping improve GPU efficiency, scale model serving, and build intelligent routing systems. This is an opportunity to get in early, take meaningful ownership, and help shape the infrastructure that will support Robinhood's next generation of AI capabilities.

This role is based in our Menlo Park office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.
