job_title: Senior Product Manager, Chat, Video, and Collaboration Integrations
description:
As the Senior Product Manager for Chat, Video and Collaboration Integrations, you will own and lead the development of integrations that connect Datadog with the tools engineers use every day, such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Zoom, Google Meet, ServiceNow, Jira and Linear. You will ensure that teams can receive alerts and notifications, collaborate in channels and meetings, take action on Datadog data, and manage tickets with bi-directional syncing between Datadog and external platforms.

 

Products across Datadog, including Incident Response, Security, Alerting, and Bits AI, use these integrations to meet teams in their existing workflows. Linking these tools with Datadog streamlines communication, accelerates issue resolution, and enhances system visibility.  These integrations also support Datadog’s agentic initiatives by giving agents like Bits AI real time context from Slack, Teams, meetings, and tickets, enabling them to understand events and act where teams work.

 

We are looking for an experienced product manager who will engage with some of the world's leading tech organizations, as well as our partners, to gain a deep understanding of their chat and collaboration needs. You will set the vision for the platform, drive the development of new capabilities, including agentic workflows grounded in real-time context, and identify new integrations as customer needs evolve.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Datadog's chat (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat), video (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams) and collaboration (ServiceNow, Jira, Linear and others) integrations, end-to-end.

  • Build integrations as a platform: frameworks, APIs and guidelines that let product teams across Datadog ship great chat, video and collaboration experiences without starting from scratch.

  • Standardize how Datadog issues and tickets sync bi-directionally across external work management systems like ServiceNow and Jira.

  • Integrate AI capabilities across collaboration tools using real-time contextual data from chats, meetings, and tickets to automate actions.

  • Deliver scalable enterprise management features, including identity mapping, administrative governance, and security controls.

  • Partner with PMs across Datadog to plan joint OKRs and decide where to invest each quarter.

  • Talk to customers constantly, from fast-moving startups to the largest enterprises. Turn what you learn into crisp PRDs, design partnerships and prioritized roadmaps.

  • Support Sales, Solutions and Customer Success on strategic deals and migrations, and equip them to sell the integration story.

  • Define and track adoption, engagement and revenue-influence metrics. Make roadmap bets and be ready to defend them.

 

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience shipping technical B2B SaaS products, including ownership of a product area with multiple engineering teams.

  • Deep experience with integrations, platforms or developer-facing APIs, ideally on chat or collaboration surfaces (Slack, Microsoft Teams) or ITSM / work-management systems (ServiceNow, Jira).

  • A track record of driving roadmaps across organizational boundaries: aligning many stakeholders with competing needs without losing speed or focus.

  • Experience working with strategic technology partners, or a clear point of view on how to build partner relationships that move a product forward.

  • Strong technical depth: you can work through webhooks, sync models, auth, rate limits and AI/LLM trade-offs with engineers. You don't need to code, but you can go deep.

  • Enterprise instincts: you understand how large organizations run IT operations, and you've designed for their complexity without giving up simplicity for everyone else.

  • Experience (or genuine interest) in developer platforms, observability, incident response, ITSM, or AI-assisted and agentic product experiences.

  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You're comfortable presenting to executives, customers and partner leadership, on stage and in a working session.

  • A bias for action in ambiguity. This is a high-impact area where the roadmap is yours to shape.

 

Benefits and Growth

  • High income earning opportunities based on individual performance

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message

  • Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Startup Products team builds Stripe Atlas and other products that help founders start and run a company, from anywhere in the world. We believe that startups are one of the most effective ways to solve the world's problems, and we want to give founders a running start — and keep them running. We help founders form their company, raise capital, execute critical legal agreements, access the internet's best tools, and automate operations while feeling ambitious, smart, and assured. Our goal is to create more startups that get to product-market fit, fast.

Our team is composed of high-agency, high-ownership product thinkers, who genuinely care about helping founders and making it easier to start and run a startup. Every person on the team is responsible for making our product the best it can be, and for ensuring our roadmap contains the highest impact ships for founders.

What you’ll do

As a Strategy & Operations partner on the Startup Products team, you’ll help determine where we should play and what we should build for founders. You’ll combine user insight, market context, product judgment, and rigorous analysis to develop strategy, shape product roadmaps, and turn our highest-potential ideas into clear, executable plans. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, design, marketing, partnerships, and other teams across Stripe to develop your recommendations.

Responsibilities

  • Develop product and business strategy for Atlas and other startup products by structuring ambiguous questions, synthesizing evidence, and making clear recommendations.
  • Turn strategy into execution by defining goals, workstreams, decision points, and operating cadences, and by helping cross-functional teams resolve tradeoffs and unblock progress.
  • Build a deep understanding of founders through direct conversations, qualitative research, product data, and support conversations.
  • Translate founder needs, market developments, and competitive dynamics into product opportunities, roadmap recommendations, and prioritization frameworks.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and design to unblock the development of new products and features from early problem definition through scope, launch, and iteration.
  • Develop business cases and opportunity assessments for new bets, including market sizing.
  • Lead targeted strategic projects, including 0→1 explorations, product or market deep dives, and initiatives that span multiple teams.
  • Communicate recommendations, decisions, progress, and results clearly to team and Stripe leadership, and build alignment through influence rather than authority.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in strategy and operations, product strategy, product management, management consulting, or another analytical and cross-functional role at a technology company.
  • Experience partnering closely with product, engineering, and design to shape product decisions and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Strong product sense and user empathy, with the ability to identify important customer problems and translate them into product or business opportunities.
  • Excellent structured problem-solving skills and the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, open-ended questions.
  • Ability to combine qualitative and quantitative evidence, challenge assumptions, and turn complex findings into practical recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • High agency, sound judgment, and a willingness to move between strategy and hands-on execution as the work requires.
  • Enthusiasm for helping founders start and grow their businesses.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with startups, founders, company formation, fintech, or products serving small and early-stage businesses.
  • Experience conducting or applying user research, shaping product roadmaps, or bringing new products from 0→1.
  • Experience using AI tools to simplify and speed up your work.

  • Drive Kubernetes compute platform evolution — define the long-term direction for cluster lifecycle, scheduling strategy, control plane architecture, and multi-region resiliency across Robinhood's entire compute fleet
  • Redesign infrastructure provisioning — transform Terraform from a collection of ad-hoc configurations into a scalable, self-service platform capability that enables rapid region provisioning and developer autonomy

What you bring

  • Deep working knowledge of Istio and/or Envoy at the source code level — including the xDS API as a protocol; experience debugging at the control-plane/data-plane boundary
  • HTTP/2 and gRPC wire-level knowledge — connection management, flow control, stream multiplexing, and observability
  • Terraform at architectural scale — module design patterns, provider internals, remote state management, and multi-region provisioning
  • Production Go or Python for infrastructure tooling; strong fundamentals in writing well-structured, tested, operationally sound code

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Link team builds the premier consumer network for next-generation commerce, leveraging our base of 300M+ registered consumers to pioneer the future of Identity, Consumer Finance, and AI-driven transactions. While our foundation was built on high-conversion merchant payments and a flexible digital wallet, we are expanding far beyond. We are building the infrastructure for a world where AI agents transact on your behalf, stablecoins go mainstream, and identity dictates how money moves.

The Consumer Preference team is building the Link experience across the web app and agents — building the wallet product consumers need to feel confident, excited, and inspired by the new ways payments and identity are changing online. As a senior member of the team, you will create new experiences such as financial insights powered by purchase history, rewards cards backed by a stablecoin balance, safe agentic purchase UX, automatic purchase protections, and subscription management.

What you’ll do

We’re hiring a Staff Full Stack Engineer to lead the design and delivery of new consumer capabilities in Link. The ideal candidate will combine technical depth across the stack with a strong product sense. In this role, you will take ambiguous product opportunities, create ways to validate them early, and ultimately ship complete products.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with broad technical and organizational scope. You will own large, cross-functional projects from early product and technical definition through launch and iteration; lead teams of engineers through complex execution; and partner closely with the many Stripe systems and teams that provide new capabilities. You will work across the stack, building services and APIs as well as user interfaces. You will make the architectural decisions that balance a high quality bar with the need to move fast and iterate quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive technical strategy across Link Consumer, connecting near-term product delivery to a cohesive, durable engineering vision.
  • Lead large, ambiguous 0→1 initiatives from problem definition and architecture through implementation, safe launch, and iteration.
  • Design, build, and maintain polished user experiences, reliable backend services, APIs, and systems.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and foundational investments early, creating incremental plans that de-risk the roadmap and accelerate future work.
  • Partner with engineering teams across Stripe, building alignment and influencing their roadmaps and priorities when Link Consumer depends on shared capabilities.
  • Champion pragmatic solutions and code patterns throughout our codebase, setting standards in React/JavaScript/CSS/GraphQL as well as Ruby APIs and LLM-powered systems
  • Ensure our UI and backend components are reliable, secure, extensible, and accessible
  • Define operational processes and lead response to production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack, growing the learning and retrospective culture on our team and driving remediations that reduce risk

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of backend and/or full-stack software development experience, with a track record of owning large, ambiguous systems end-to-end.
  • Demonstrated technical experience leading the design and delivery of large, complex software projects from early definition through production launch.
  • Strong full-stack engineering skills, including experience building reliable backend services and polished user-facing product experiences.
  • Experience leading and unblocking a group of engineers on a substantial project as a senior individual contributor.
  • Ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments: framing problems, making durable technical decisions, and creating an actionable path forward.
  • Excellent cross-functional and cross-organizational collaboration skills, with the ability to align teams with different systems, priorities, and constraints.
  • Strong engineering judgment around system reliability, operational excellence, security, and maintainability.
  • A product-minded approach to engineering, with a focus on delivering meaningful outcomes for users and the business.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Java, Ruby, and/or TypeScript. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than expertise in a particular language or framework.
  • Experience building payments, money-movement, fintech, or other regulated financial products.
  • Experience building consumer products at scale, particularly products that require a high degree of user trust.
  • Experience working on 0→1 products or taking new capabilities from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Familiarity with LLM-powered products, evals, or agentic assistants.
  • Appreciation for the importance of strong distribution and taking pride in seeing projects through to successful completion.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Robinhood is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Build team: the small, high-leverage team that turns the company's best AI-built prototypes into true enterprise-grade services. Robinhood has gone all-in on an AI-accelerated workforce: every week, Hoodies across Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, and beyond use sanctioned AI tools to build working prototypes of the tools they wish they had. The best of those ideas deserve to become real software. That is this team's entire job, and yours. 

The team is built on the premise that AI multiplies what a senior engineer can own: agents do the first pass of assessment, porting, and scaffolding; you review, harden, and decide. The work is a distinctive loop.  A prototype earns real usage in our experimental sandbox and arrives through a single front door. You assess it, decide what survives, often the idea and the workflow, rarely the code, and rebuild it as an enterprise-grade, production-spec service that meets our full engineering standards: SSO, audit logging, secrets management, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and security review, baked in from the first commit. While you build, you work directly with business partners, the forward-deployed pattern, pointed inward. Robinhood operates in a heavily regulated industry. description:

The AI Platform & Agentic Apps team builds the agent platform behind every AI agent at Robinhood. Today it gives a growing number of engineers and employees an AI teammate that ships code, queries data, and runs operational workflows on their behalf. We're building toward the same platform powering the agents millions of customers interact with directly, in real time. These agents don't just answer questions — they're designed to take real action across carefully curated meta harnesses. This is agentic AI at real scale, in a regulated financial environment, and it will change how Robinhood works!

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the AI Platform & Agentic Apps team, you will design and build the harness that every agent at Robinhood runs on. A critical part of the role is making those agents trustworthy at scale: trajectory-level evals that measure how an agent reasons and acts, and action guardrails — permission models, approval gates, and sandboxing — built as platform primitives that other teams adopt. You'll be a technical anchor on a growing, high-caliber team, collaborating with product, infrastructure, and fellow ML engineers to take ambitious ideas from zero to one and into production. You'll help define the team's technical direction, mentor engineers, and shape how Robinhood decides an agent is ready to ship. This role offers a rare combination of technical depth, platform-scale impact, and the satisfaction of building systems that genuinely don't exist anywhere else.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and build the core of Robinhood's agent harness — orchestration, tool integrations, context and memory management — so one platform can safely power both high-trust internal agents and tightly scoped customer-facing ones.
  • Ship agentic applications end to end on that harness, from an ambiguous problem to a production agent that takes real action on behalf of employees or customers, and feed what you learn back into the platform.
  • Build trajectory-level evaluation systems that score how an agent got to an answer, not just the answer — tool-call correctness, planning and recovery, multi-step task completion — backed by simulation environments and synthetic task generation.
  • Architect action guardrails as platform primitives: least-privilege tool scoping, permission models, human-approval gates for high-risk or irreversible actions, step and budget limits, sandboxing, and rollback.
  • Make evals and guardrails products other teams adopt — SDKs, CI regression gates on prompt, model, and tool changes, continuous red-teaming, and production tracing that closes the loop from real traffic back into eval sets and guardrail models.
  • Set the technical bar through architecture reviews, code reviews, and mentorship, and be the person who can make — and defend with data — the "don't ship" call.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or ML-focused software engineer, with strong Python and distributed-systems fundamentals and a track record of shipping LLM-powered systems to production at scale. A Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Hands-on experience building agentic systems end to end — tool use, orchestration, context management, multi-step planning — on top of frontier models, in production.
  • Deep expertise evaluating agents: you've built trajectory-level evals, tool-call scoring, and simulation environments, and you can articulate why final-answer accuracy is insufficient for systems that act.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing action-level guardrails — permission and tool-scoping models, approval gates, blast-radius controls, and sandboxing — for agents operating in systems where mistakes have consequences.
  • Rigor in evaluation methodology: golden datasets, rubric and LLM-as-judge grading and their failure modes, statistical significance with small N, offline-to-online metric correlation, and eval data versioning and contamination control.
  • Proven ability to build platforms, not just models: you've shipped eval, safety, or agent tooling that other engineering teams adopted, and you have the judgment to know when to build versus buy.

  • Act as a force multiplier through mentoring, technical influence, and contributions to hiring and engineering culture

job_title: Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector, Federal & Defense
description:
Datadog is looking for an experienced Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector to own marketing strategy and execution for our U.S. Federal and Defense business. In this role, you will build and run an integrated, multi-channel field marketing program across Federal Civilian agencies, Federal Systems Integrators, the Department of War (DoW/DoD), and the Defense Industrial Base. 

This will span mission-focused events, executive briefings, account-based programs, and digital campaigns, in close partnership with Public Sector sales leadership.

The role is a full-funnel mandate with the latitude to prioritize the programs that move pipeline in a market where the buying cycle, the procurement path, and the compliance bar all look different from commercial tech.

Datadog for Government operates in a FedRAMP High-certified, AWS GovCloud (US) environment, with work underway toward DoD Impact Level 5. You will be the marketer who translates that platform and compliance story into mission language for program offices, CIOs, and the integrators who build for them.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Set the strategy for, and execute, the integrated Federal and Defense field marketing plan — aligned to Public Sector sales priorities, target agencies and programs, and pipeline goals. You will propose the pipeline target for this segment, not just deliver against one handed to you.
  • Build segment-specific program tracks for Federal Civilian, Federal Systems Integrator, DoW/DoD, and Defense Industrial Base audiences, recognizing that each buys on a different cycle and responds to different proof.
  • Own Datadog’s presence across the federal event calendar, from large-scale defense and civilian conferences to service association events, agency industry days, virtual events, and targeted executive gatherings.
  • Build the program formats that move federal buyers through the funnel — executive briefings, technical workshops, roundtables, and webinars — owning Federal and Defense field marketing budget, audience strategy, target account recruitment, and follow-through.
  • Work with Product Marketing to shape Federal-specific messaging and content: FedRAMP High, IL5 progress, data residency, U.S.-persons operations, continuous ATO, zero trust, and the compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, CMMC, DISA STIGs) your audience is actually measured against.
  • Partner with Demand Generation on campaign strategy and execution. Adapt nurture tracks and email motions for a federal audience, manage lead flow and follow-up SLAs with sales, and tune programs based on funnel performance You bring the market context that makes a central campaign land with the audience, and you own stage-over-stage conversion for the segment.
  • Raise the bar for the wider field marketing team — mentor less experienced marketers, and bring federal market expertise back into how the broader org plans.

Who You Are:

  • 6+ years of field marketing experience in B2B SaaS, including 4+ years marketing to the U.S. Federal government, with a demonstrated track record of driving pipeline for a public sector segment or business unit.
  • Direct experience with Defense buyers — DoW/DoD services and combatant commands, or the Federal Systems Integrator and Defense Industrial Base firms that serve them.
  • Fluent in the federal buying cycle: appropriations and fiscal-year dynamics, contract vehicles (GSA, SEWP, CIO-SP, GWACs), the role of resellers and integrators, and how an ATO actually gets granted.
  • Proven experience planning and executing large-scale federal events, executive forums, and sponsored trade shows.
  • Comfortable with the technical subject matter — observability, cloud, DevSecOps, or cybersecurity — and tune messaging that holds up with a technical federal audience.
  • Experience with account-based marketing against named agencies and programs.
  • Experience owning a program budget and reporting against a pipeline number you are accountable for.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with strong executive presence, and a track record of influencing sales leadership and driving alignment across marketing functions.
  • A self-starter who makes confident decisions without a playbook in front of you, and who is comfortable being handed an ambiguous goal and coming back with the plan.
  • Hands-on with Salesforce, marketing automation, ABM platforms, and attribution tooling.
  • U.S. citizenship required.
  • Based in or willing to relocate to the Washington, D.C. metro area, with willingness to travel roughly 40% for events.

job_title: Manager, Software Engineering - Design Systems Adherence
location_display: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As the Engineering Manager for Design Systems Adherence, you'll lead the team building the workflows, tools, and quality feedback loops that help customers create design and code that correctly adheres to their design system when working with Figma’s Agents. This work spans context engineering i.e making guidelines, examples, and documentation useful to AI, agent architecture improvements as well as creating  datasets, evaluators, and benchmarks that show how well outputs follow a customer's design system. You'll set strategy across these areas, raise the bar on adherence measurement, and turn evaluation results and customer feedback into feedback loops that make design quality better.

This is a high-impact opportunity to shape Figma's Agent and improve overall design quality. An organization’s Design System is one of the key differentiators of design quality as we can use it to make agent output adhere to their specific brand, products and design language. We are also aiming to solve Design <> Code parity and minimize drift away from the defined design system in both code and designs.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Lead and grow a 6-8 engineer team responsible for Design Systems Adherence across our workflows
  • Coach and develop engineers through career growth, feedback, and technical leadership, building a culture of ownership and high-quality execution
  • Own and evolve design system context: make guidelines, examples, documentation, and other guidance available to AI as useful, actionable context that improves how it applies a customer's system
  • Set the technical strategy for adherence measurement - including high-fidelity evaluation datasets, quality rubrics, evaluators, and deterministic regression checks that catch issues as Figma's Agent evolves
  • Build benchmarking, tools, and dashboards that help Figma and customers understand design system adherence and act on the results, while tracking visual quality, latency, and cost
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, and AI Research teams at Figma to achieve business impact

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience leading and growing high-impact engineering teams with a track record of strong impact
  • Hands-on depth in building AI assistants, evaluation systems, and using the latest large language models and harnesses
  • Fluency with modern AI development and evaluation workflows, such as context management, dataset curation, automated evaluators, benchmarking, and regression testing
  • A strong foundation in software engineering and a platform mindset: you build tools and systems other teams adopt and rely on, alongside workflows that solve real customer problems
  • A high quality bar for customer experience, data quality, and reliable measurement, and the ability to set technical direction and drive cross-functional alignment in complex environments

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Strong understanding of design systems, including components, tokens, usage guidelines, and their integration across design and code
  • Proven ability to establish evaluation and customer feedback loops to continuously improve AI products
  • Skilled in benchmarking AI products across output quality, latency, and cost, translating findings into actionable product priorities
  • Track record of developing shared evaluation tools, curated datasets, or dashboards to measure quality and prevent regressions

You will also serve as a product specialist for the broader Account Executive team, building the playbooks, deal structures, and GTM motion that scale this business.

Responsibilities

  • Own quota and commercial responsibility across FX Acquiring, Multicurrency Settlement, and Currency Conversion, prospecting and closing deals with global merchants and platforms
  • Structure and negotiate holistic multi-currency deals that bundle MCS and Currency Conversion, pricing across both products to deliver merchant value while capturing the full multi-currency management relationship for Stripe
  • Engage C-suite and treasury stakeholders—including CFOs, Treasurers, and Engineering leaders—to articulate Stripe's multi-currency value proposition and displace competitors managing FX flows off-platform
  • Serve as the FX and multi-currency GTM product specialist for the broader Account Executive team, partnering on complex deals and helping build repeatable sales motions
  • Build and execute go-to-market strategies for new product segments, including pitch frameworks, displacement playbooks, and bundled pricing approaches

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe builds financial infrastructure for businesses—from ambitious startups to global enterprises. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we’re building the tools that help businesses participate in and grow the global economy.

About the team

Stripe’s Crypto team is building financial infrastructure for a world where money moves as easily as information. Across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy, we help businesses build products powered by stablecoins, wallets, and programmable money movement.

Open Issuance is central to that opportunity. Built by Bridge, a Stripe company, it enables businesses to launch and manage their own stablecoins. Alongside it, Open Standard—the independent organization behind Open USD (OUSD)—is building a shared stablecoin network with broad distribution and economics designed to benefit the businesses driving adoption. 

We’re hiring one of the founding sellers of our Open Issuance go-to-market team. You’ll partner closely with Open Standard and teams across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy on a major strategic bet: challenging the stablecoin duopoly and giving businesses more choice, control, and participation in the economics of digital dollars.

This is an opportunity to help build a market—not simply sell into an established one.

What you’ll do

You’ll own new-business development with high-potential businesses building the next generation of financial products. You’ll help founders, executives, and technical teams understand where stablecoins can create meaningful value, whether through adopting OUSD or launching their own stablecoin with Open Issuance.

As a founding seller, you’ll shape the strategy as well as execute it. You’ll identify early customers, develop compelling commercial use cases, close complex deals, and turn those engagements into a repeatable sales motion. You should be equally comfortable opening doors, working through technical and commercial details, and creating structure where no playbook exists.

Responsibilities

  • Own a revenue target and the full sales lifecycle, from proactive prospecting and qualification through negotiation, closing, launch, and expansion.
  • Build a net-new pipeline of companies, platforms, fintechs, and other businesses with strong potential to adopt OUSD or Open Issuance.
  • Develop trusted relationships with founders, CEOs, CFOs, and product and engineering leaders, translating complex infrastructure into a clear business case.
  • Partner closely with Open Standard to develop opportunities, coordinate customer engagements, and grow adoption of OUSD.
  • Help customers evaluate opportunities across stablecoin issuance, global money movement, treasury, payouts, and emerging AI and agentic-commerce use cases.
  • Lead technically and commercially complex sales in partnership with Solutions Architecture, Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance.
  • Help define the team’s initial customer segments, qualification criteria, positioning, commercial approaches, and operating cadence.
  • Bring structured customer and competitive feedback to Product and Engineering, influencing what we build and how we bring it to market.
  • Turn early wins into repeatable playbooks while remaining hands-on in prospecting, deal execution, and customer launches.

Who you are

We’re looking for a seller who combines a hunter’s drive with a builder’s mindset. You’re motivated by ambitious targets, but equally interested in understanding how a product works and why a customer should adopt it. You can earn credibility with technical founders, navigate complex organizations, and make progress when the product, market, and sales motion are evolving.

If you meet the minimum requirements, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a prerequisite.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of customer-facing experience in technology, fintech, crypto, payments, or financial infrastructure, with a track record of strong commercial performance.
  • Demonstrated success generating your own pipeline and winning net-new business.
  • Experience leading complex, consultative sales involving multiple stakeholders and customized commercial agreements.
  • Ability to become a trusted advisor to senior business leaders while engaging credibly with product and technical teams.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect a customer’s business model, money flows, and product strategy to a compelling solution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain unfamiliar technical concepts clearly.
  • Comfort operating with autonomy, navigating ambiguity, and building processes rather than relying on an established playbook.
  • A collaborative approach and a willingness to take ownership of the work required to help customers succeed.

Preferred qualifications

    • Experience selling to AI-native companies, developer platforms, fintechs, wallets, or crypto-native businesses.
    • Experience with stablecoins, issuance, treasury, cross-border payments, or embedded finance.
    • Experience selling API-based infrastructure or bringing regulated financial products to market.
    • Experience as an early or founding seller who helped build a new product’s go-to-market motion.
    • Familiarity with agentic commerce and the financial infrastructure needs of AI-driven businesses.

You will:

  • Work alongside Stripe users and partners, bringing their voices, ambitions, and experiences into campaigns, announcements, and other communications.

Singapore (currently residing, or willing to relocate).

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Corporate Security Systems and Infrastructure (CSI) team safeguards Stripe’s people, offices, and operations by designing, delivering, and maintaining secure infrastructure across our global workplace portfolio. We take an intelligence-led, risk-based approach and partner closely with Workplace, IT, Security Operations, Legal, and external vendors to build reliable, scalable physical security systems and transition them to our Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) for ongoing monitoring and support.

What you’ll do

As a Corporate Security Infrastructure Project Manager, you will lead the security infrastructure workstream for new offices, expansions, relocations, and major workplace upgrades, with an initial focus on Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) and support for global projects as needed. You will manage projects from early site assessment and design through installation, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.

You will be accountable for scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder alignment across a portfolio of concurrent projects. In addition to delivering individual projects, you will strengthen the CSI program by improving standards, documentation, vendor performance, reporting, and repeatable project management processes. You will work through ambiguity, surface decisions early, and communicate clearly with technical teams, business partners, vendors, and senior leaders.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of security infrastructure for office construction and expansion projects, from site assessment and requirements definition through design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
  • Lead requests for proposals (RFPs) for security installations, including defining scope and requirements, coordinating bidders, reviewing submissions, evaluating proposals with relevant stakeholders, and supporting vendor selection recommendations.
  • Own project scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, decisions, and change control; provide clear, outcome-focused reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Coordinate security designs and technical requirements with Workplace, IT, Security Operations, Legal, architects, general contractors, landlords, and other project partners.
  • Review design drawings, specifications, bills of materials, and implementation plans to ensure alignment with CSI standards and local requirements.
  • Manage security integrators, consultants, and contractors, including statements of work, delivery milestones, quality expectations, service levels, and performance reviews.
  • Oversee system installation, acceptance testing, commissioning, punch-list resolution, documentation, and first-day-of-business readiness.
  • Ensure completed projects are smoothly handed over to the GSOC and support teams, with accurate system records, operating procedures, training, and ownership established.
  • Maintain and improve global construction standards, technical specifications, project templates, runbooks, and closeout documentation.
  • Develop and track project health metrics, vendor KPIs, budget forecasts, and lessons learned; use insights to improve delivery quality, predictability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support new market and site evaluations by identifying security risks, infrastructure constraints, integration needs, and mitigation options.
  • Support the security repair and maintenance program, with a focus on the EMEA region, collaborating with regional teams to triage, track, and resolve security system and hardware issues.
  • Partner with CSI engineers and program leadership to prioritize work, resolve cross-project dependencies, and scale consistent processes across the portfolio.
  • Travel up to 25%, including international travel, to support site assessments, project milestones, commissioning, and handover.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of project management experience delivering complex physical security, workplace technology, low-voltage, construction, or similarly technical infrastructure projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects across the full lifecycle, with ownership of scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder communication.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery among technical teams, business partners, design and construction teams, vendors, and senior leaders.
  • Strong vendor and contractor management skills, including defining requirements, managing contracts or statements of work, tracking delivery, and addressing performance issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical details into clear decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and next steps for different audiences.
  • Strong judgment and structured problem-solving skills; able to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, anticipate issues, and drive timely decisions.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accurate documentation, standards, and operational handoffs.
  • Experience establishing project management processes, tracking performance metrics, and applying lessons learned to improve future delivery.
  • Working knowledge of physical security systems such as access control, video management, intrusion detection, intercoms, low-voltage infrastructure, and door hardware.
  • Ability to travel internationally up to 25%.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience delivering security infrastructure for offices in multiple countries or regions, particularly in EMEA.
  • Experience with Genetec Security Center, including Synergis, Omnicast, Security Center SaaS, or Stratocast; active Genetec certification is a plus.
  • Familiarity with system integrations, networking fundamentals, APIs, webhooks, or cloud-managed security technologies.
  • Experience managing budgets, forecasts, vendor KPIs, SLAs, and portfolio-level reporting.
  • Experience using project management and workflow tools such as Jira and Smartsheet.
  • Experience reviewing and marking up construction and security design documentation using Bluebeam Revu or a similar PDF design-review tool, along with knowledge of commissioning practices and relevant local codes or regulatory requirements.
  • A bachelor’s degree in project management, construction management, security management, information technology, engineering, or a related field; or a relevant professional certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, ASIS PSP/CPP, or SIA CSPM.
  • Ability to select and use appropriate AI tools to improve work, while critically evaluating and refining outputs for accuracy and quality.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Credit Risk team is responsible for managing the credit risk generated by businesses processing payments on Stripe. The team combines commercial underwriting, portfolio management, analytics, and cross-functional partnership to protect Stripe from financial loss while enabling strong businesses to grow. The APAC Credit Risk team supports a diverse portfolio of businesses across the region. We partner closely with Sales, Legal, Treasury, Finance, Product, Operations, and other Risk teams to make sound, timely credit decisions and develop scalable approaches to managing risk.

What you’ll do

You will underwrite and manage a portfolio of Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing businesses across APAC. You will evaluate complex business models and financial information, develop clear credit recommendations, and identify mitigations that protect Stripe while supporting sustainable user growth.

Responsibilities

  • You will underwrite and manage a portfolio of Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing businesses across APAC and Greater China Region. You will evaluate complex business models and financial information, develop clear credit recommendations, and identify mitigations that protect Stripe while supporting sustainable user growth
  • Evaluate business models, financial statements, cash-flow forecasts, transaction patterns, and other relevant information to assess credit risk.
  • Develop clear, data-driven credit recommendations and tailored risk mitigations that balance Stripe’s exposure with users’ ability to grow.

Stripe's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the shared platforms that make it possible for engineering teams to build, deploy, run, and scale reliable products. The organization owns foundational capabilities across service networking and discovery, safe feature and configuration changes, data storage and orchestration, and batch computing.

Our platforms support a global engineering audience and power systems at significant scale. description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 

About the team:

We build impactful experiences that drive awareness of Stripe, educate users and prospects on Stripe solutions, foster community, and deliver high quality leads to our sales team.

 

What you’ll do:

This role is responsible for leading the event registration strategy for the Corporate Events team, developing streamlined processes and tailored experiences for diverse attendee types. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient execution of registration from planning through post-event analysis while maintaining compliance and aligning strategies across global markets. By analyzing data and preparing insights, you will inform decisions that maximize attendance and enhance the overall attendee experience. Additionally, you will manage the development of the event mobile app, ensuring it integrates seamlessly with the registration process and enhances attendee engagement. You will also contribute to compelling promotional materials and ensure communication consistency across all registration touchpoints. Reporting to the Stripe Sessions event lead, this position requires you to work autonomously and present well-prepared recommendations.

 

Responsibilities: 

Strategy and concept development:

  • Lead event registration for all events the Corporate Events team works on, including pricing models, simple and elegant attendee flows, and promotional tactics to maximize attendance and revenue where applicable. 
  • Design and document distinct registration experiences tailored to different attendee types, outlining flows, content requirements, email communications, calendar invites, nurture campaigns, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Establish and document registration policies for each event based on historical data and event goals.
  • Work with Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, and Product Marketing teams to analyze large data sets, identifying trends and insights to guide future event strategies.
  • Collaborate with the Web Presence and Platform team to define the annual events web roadmap, assess available design and engineering resources, break down web projects into phases as needed, and create timelines that prioritize key deliverables.
  • Collaborate with Copywriting and the Event lead to craft landing page copy for all promotional pages, ensuring that event themes, value propositions, and key information are prominently highlighted.
  • Understand the Stripe writing style guide to craft clear communications for all transactional registration journeys. Collaborate with the Copywriting and Demand Generation teams to support additional messaging and reviews for event marketing emails.
  • Understand the internal and vendor systems involved in the registration process to facilitate seamless data movement between each and support registration workflows.
  • Collaborate with the Legal team to maintain compliance in registration forms, regularly reviewing and updating practices as regulations evolve.
  • Collaborate with the Web Funnel teams to ensure registration form fields are consistent with the contact sales form and Salesforce data.
  • Collaborate with security teams to adhere to established procedures for screening event registrants, and establish communication protocols to be utilized as needed.
  • Define and implement a registration strategy for the event mobile app, ensuring a user-friendly interface and seamless integration with the overall registration process.
  • Analyze user engagement and feedback from the mobile app to identify opportunities for improvement and incorporate insights into future app development and event strategies.

 

Planning and execution:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define clear roles and responsibilities, ensuring efficient coordination.
  • Work with global teams to align registration strategies and ensure effective execution across diverse markets and regions.
  • Oversee the entire registration project lifecycle for all events within the Corporate Events team, ensuring seamless execution from the planning phase to onsite management and post-event analysis.
  • Ensure consistency across all registration materials, including forms, email communications, and event websites, in alignment with brand guidelines to create a cohesive attendee experience.
  • Prepare and distribute weekly registration reports to executives and leadership, offering insights on progress toward goals, attendance trends, and recommendations for improvement.
  • Facilitate weekly planning meetings with internal and external teams to ensure alignment and effective collaboration.
  • Contribute to the quality control process for promotional landing pages and registration forms, ensuring they launch on time and meet Stripe’s quality standards.
  • Conduct quality control and audits on registration data to identify discrepancies and maintain accurate records for reporting and analysis.
  • Prepare onsite registration and check-in processes, contingency plans, and escalation procedures, ensuring their execution as planned during the event.
  • Collaborate with the Event Lead and Brand team to develop a comprehensive strategy for attendee badging, ensuring that all attendee types are effectively considered and included in the plan.
  • Take ownership of onsite attendee scanning plans and data upload initiatives, while closely collaborating with the Demand Generation team to develop an effective attendee follow-up plan.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for onsite registration escalations, collaborating with agency partners and security to ensure that pre-event attendee screening protocols are maintained throughout the onsite experience.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to align the mobile app experience with overall event branding, messaging, and promotional strategies, creating a cohesive and engaging attendee journey.
  • Oversee the development and execution of the event mobile app, ensuring that it is functional, user-friendly, and compatible with all event-related activities.
  • Facilitate mobile app testing and quality control processes to ensure a smooth launch and operation, addressing any technical issues before and during the event.
  • Travel required to support onsite execution.

 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience using Slack, Salesforce, Marketo, Google drive, Figma, and Asana.  
  • Experience working in international environments with an understanding of regional differences that may impact registration strategies.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing principles and tools, including SEO, email marketing, and social media promotion, to boost event visibility and engagement.

 

Minimum requirements:

  • 6+ years of experience in event registration management for both paid external and internal events.
  • Proficiency with event registration software and technical tools, leveraging technology to streamline processes and enhance attendee experiences.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, capable of interpreting data to provide actionable insights.
  • Strong project management expertise with a proven track record of managing multiple concurrent projects.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills for building relationships across departments and with external partners.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, committed to maintaining quality and consistency.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities and adaptability to navigate changing environments while prioritizing effectively.
  • Collaborative and creative mindset, thriving in dynamic, fast-paced work environments.
  • Proficient in influencing, problem-solving, and consensus-building with experience in managing complex projects.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills.
  • Skilled in developing scalable processes and automation.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities and handle unforeseen challenges with quick solutions in high-pressure situations.

It also identifies control weaknesses, coordinates complex investigations, and supports local examinations and inquiries from financial partners, law enforcement, and other external stakeholders.

What you’ll do

We are looking for a financial crime professional with Luxembourg- and EU-specific experience to join the EMEA Investigations Management team. Based in Luxembourg, you will focus primarily on Bridge Building S.A. while also supporting Stripe’s broader investigations work.

As an Investigator on the EMEA Investigations Management team, you will:

  • Review high-risk investigative casework and provide 2LoD oversight across a wide variety of financial crime risk types
  • Prepare and submit Luxembourg Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the Cellule de renseignement financier (CRF) for Bridge Building S.A., working closely with the MLRO and in line with established governance
  • Oversee local customer risk decisions for Bridge Building S.A., including matters escalated through country- or entity-specific risk management forums, in close partnership with the MLRO and Investigations Leads
  • Review high-risk sanctions investigations, such as potential matches against relevant regional lists, and handle related submissions
  • Use and evolve AI and agentic tools to enhance casework research and analysis, surface actionable intelligence, and improve investigative workflows while applying expert judgement and maintaining human oversight of risk decisions and regulatory filings
  • Assess casework to produce clear investigative analyses, intelligence briefs, and other decision-ready outputs that identify threats, support reporting workstreams, and inform MLROs, RCOs, and other stakeholders
  • Identify potential control gaps through casework analysis and recommend solutions to mitigate financial crime risks across the programme and in individual cases
  • Serve as a point of contact for investigation-related inquiries from law enforcement and FIUs, financial partners, auditors, and other external stakeholders
  • Demonstrate sound judgement and the ability to navigate complex, high-risk cases where the correct decision may not be immediately clear

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in investigative roles within financial crime, AML, risk, intelligence research, or a related field
  • Fluency in English and French
  • Demonstrated experience preparing regulatory disclosures, including direct experience with Luxembourg STR filings and goAML
  • A deep understanding of financial technologies, including payments, cryptocurrency, stablecoins, and Banking-as-a-Service products
  • Strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU AML, terrorist financing, and sanctions regulations
  • Stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work effectively with MLROs and communicate complex risk decisions clearly
  • Excellent research and writing skills and the ability to produce concise, decision-ready investigative outputs
  • The ability to synthesise large amounts of information, including transaction data, using tools such as SQL, Excel, and AI
  • The ability to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced environment
  • The ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion

Preferred qualifications

  • ACAMS or a similar professional certification
  • Familiarity with macOS and Google products
  • Technical curiosity and an interest in evolving financial crime compliance trends

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

About the team

The APAC Payments TechOps team ensures the accuracy of financial data flowing through Stripe's payment infrastructure, manages aging balances, maintains compliance with partner and regulatory requirements, and builds tooling to detect and resolve data quality issues at scale. Through the internship, you will work with real financial data, gain experience in payments data analysis and operational problem-solving, and have opportunities to present your work to your team and the wider org. Each intern has a dedicated intern manager, and every project is part of the team's roadmap and will directly help Stripe's mission.

What you’ll do

Every internship at Stripe centers around a real, legitimate project that our team urgently needs. We will support you in shipping it. Yes, you will actually ship it. Example projects include building data quality checks for payment flows, creating dashboards to surface aging balance trends, automating compliance reporting, or analyzing cost structures across partner networks. As a Stripe intern, you'll be tackling important projects while working alongside exceptional people who insist on doing their best work. You'll learn from people with high standards who are great at inspiring others to do more and go further. We value technical and personal growth, and see our internship program as a vehicle to foster both.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze financial data by writing queries and examining data quality, reconciliation accuracy, or cost structures across Stripe's payment flows
  • Write code or build tooling that will be used in production and has meaningful impact to Stripe's payment operations
  • Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews, data model discussions, or analysis walkthroughs
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and finance stakeholders to seek and incorporate feedback on your work
  • Learn quickly by asking great questions, by working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, and by communicating the status of your work clearly

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

  • A strong fundamental understanding of quantitative analysis through pursuit of a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in computer science, data science, finance, economics, information systems, or a related discipline
  • Some experience and familiarity with programming or data analysis, either through side projects or coursework. We work mostly in SQL, Python, and Ruby. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present
  • Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts

Preferred qualifications

  • At least 2 years of university education, or equivalent work experience
  • Familiarity with SQL and querying relational databases, either through coursework or personal projects
  • Interest in payments, fintech, or financial systems
  • Comfort with developer tools (e.g. git) and data visualization
  • A strong interest in understanding how financial data flows through complex payment systems and ensuring its accuracy
  • Ability to write clearly to explain analytical findings to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About the team

Stripe Terminal helps Stripe users extend their online presence into the physical world. The Terminal team’s mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has done for online payments. With Terminal, businesses can unlock in-person payments use cases that are right for their business model—whether it’s creating a flagship retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling a mobile point-of-sale at their next event. 

We are looking for:

You will be responsible for all aspects of software development, which includes building, writing automated tests, and deploying software on our embedded payments platforms. This team works closely with partner teams throughout the hardware and software product lifecycle, from hardware manufacturing to Android application teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop and maintain user interfaces and underlying functionality for embedded point-of-sale software that handle secure payment processing across several products simultaneously.
  • Implement industry standard protocols to match product capabilities.
  • Create, maintain, and execute application unit tests as part of Continuous Integration.
  • Analyze bug reports and manage the defect resolution process (disposition issues, resolve issues, and report issue status).
  • Work closely with QA staff to ensure appropriate test cases are created, maintained, and executed.
  • Collaborate on system-side code, communication protocol design, and kernel development.
  • Interact with global teams with excellent communication skills to provide support information.
  • Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation.
  • Assist in ensuring quality and timeliness of product and feature development.
  • Proactively solve problems and work independently and within a team environment, with limited guidance.
  • Work closely with your hardware counterparts on product design and have the ability to read schematics, provide feedback on I/O mapping, developing manufacturing test software to ensure the devices are built to specification.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2+ years software development experience.
  • 2+ years working with embedded, mobile, or other connected devices.
  • Proficiency in embedded programming language C.
  • Experience using automated testing, build systems, or device firmware communication.
  • Experience with embedded systems, knowledge of operating systems, familiarity with software development tools, understanding of hardware-software interfaces.
  • Experience architecting and developing multithreaded applications, preferably in embedded systems.
  • Experience with common communications protocols (e.g., SPI, UART, I2C, USB, and others), debugging practices (e.g., JTAG and associated GDB integrations), and basic electrical design principles.
  • Experience adding, monitoring and parsing telemetry data to proactively resolve issues.
  • Degree in CS, EE, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in C++ or Golang is highly advantageous.
  • Experience developing on ARM platforms.
  • Experience with point-of-sale hardware and peripherals.
  • Knowledge of EMV standards and payment protocols.
  • Knowledge of PCI standards, transaction processing, and related retail payment technologies.
  • Knowledge of low-level security architectures, including TrustZone, anti-tamper mechanisms, Secure Boot, and Hardware Root of Trust.
  • Knowledge of foundational cryptography, including symmetric/asymmetric algorithms and secure key exchange protocols.

In this role, you will be part of the team that supports and builds food programs worldwide, from our food philosophy and safety standards to our vendor management and feedback systems. Our team is strategically distributed across all regions but operating as one cohesive unit that shares ownership of our entire global portfolio. To further strengthen our ability to provide real-time partnership across all time zones, we are looking for a leader as a Food Experience Manager to join us. This role reports to the Global Head of Food, and is based in South San Francisco.

What you’ll do

As a Food Experience Manager, you will be a key architect of our global food programs, based in our Oyster Point Headquarters, but with a worldwide impact.

Responsibilities

  • Global Program Builder: You will take the lead in designing, building, and documenting our scalable, global "playbooks" for core operational functions (e.g., vendor QBRs, new site launches, budget management).
  • Drive Global Program Execution: You will be responsible for the successful execution of our global standards across a fluid portfolio of offices, which may span multiple regions. Your role is to ensure consistency, compliance, and high performance, regardless of location.
  • Synthesize Global Data: You will analyze user feedback and operational data from across our entire global portfolio to identify systemic trends, risks, and opportunities, transforming that data into actionable business intelligence for the whole team.
  • Lead High-Stakes Vendor Partnerships: You will manage the relationship and performance of our strategic food service partner(s), ensuring strict adherence to our Statements of Work (SOWs) and leading rigorous Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
  • Advise on Global Growth: As a direct partner to the Global Head of Food, you will serve as a strategic advisor for all new office builds and expansions, providing expert input on design and operational readiness, no matter the location.
  • Developing communication strategies: Lead program change by developing adoption plans, training, and communication strategies that drive consistent execution across regions.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about food and hospitality but thinks like a systems architect for a global product. While deep hospitality experience is a plus, we are excited to consider exceptional candidates from diverse operational backgrounds, including tech, logistics, or high-end retail, who have a proven track record of building scalable, user-obsessed systems.

  • You are an expert in creating world-class customer experiences and are obsessed with using scalable, data-driven systems to deliver them consistently across cultures.
  • You have a proven track record of managing complex, multi-unit or multi-regional operations, and have experience building a single, consistent standard and deploying it across a diverse portfolio.
  • You are deeply analytical and data-fluent, able to synthesize disparate data sets from multiple regions into a single, cohesive strategic narrative.
  • You are a "first-principles" thinker who is energized by questioning industry conventions and building something new.
  • You are a natural stakeholder manager, able to partner effectively with cross-functional teams like Real Estate, Finance, and Legal to influence outcomes.
  • You have direct experience managing high-stakes third-party vendor relationships, including contract negotiation and performance management.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of leadership experience building and scaling complex, customer-facing operations (e.g., in the food & beverage, high-end retail, or tech industries).
  • Direct experience in concept development, multi-unit operations, or scaling a service-oriented business.
  • Demonstrable experience managing a P&L and using data to drive business decisions.
